final: WITH calcs AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.location, (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL) as overspend_ratio FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount != 0), grouped AS (SELECT link_to_event, location, AVG(overspend_ratio) as average FROM calcs GROUP BY link_to_event, location), ranked AS (SELECT link_to_event, location, average, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN average IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, average DESC) as rank FROM grouped) SELECT link_to_event, location, average, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY location, rank
